Airlines Finalize Orders for Boeing 737 MAX Aircraft

Turkish Airlines has finalized an order for up to 150 Boeing 737 MAX aircraft. Separately, India's Akasa Air is reportedly in talks with Boeing to order 200 737 MAX aircraft. Details on a potential Bangladesh purchase of Boeing models were also mentioned.
